Inclusion Criteria:
Type II diabetic patients, 18 years and older, were included if the participants had:
  1

severe non-PDR in either eyes with/without diabetic macular edema;
  2

right.raw_text:
ETDRS letters-measured best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA) ranging from 20/40 to 20/320 Snellen equivalent;     
  3

left.raw_text: no previous treatment (of any type) in either eye

history of prior laser treatment  [OR] or vitrectomy in the study eye;
  2

right.raw_text:
history of thromboembolic event - including myocardial infarction  [OR] or cerebral vascular accident;
  3

left.raw_text:
major surgery within the prior 6 months  [OR] or planned within the next 28 days;
  4

history of glaucoma  [OR] or ocular hypertension;
  5

right.raw_text:
loss of vision as a result of other causes;
  6

left.raw_text:
history of systemic corticosteroid therapy within the last 3 months;
  7

right.raw_text:
severe systemic disease other than diabetes mellitus;
  8

left.raw_text:
known coagulation  [OR] abnormalities or current use of anticoagulative medication other than aspirin
  9

right.raw_text: any condition that could affect followup  [OR] or documentation (including preretinal  [OR] or vitreous hemorrhage)
